chars.HAJ: a heavy-set Moroccan man in his sixties with a short grey beard, wearing a cream short-sleeve shirt, beige chinos, a white knit skullcap and a gold watch
chars.DAUGHTER: a young Moroccan woman about 21 with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a fitted lilac blouse, white wide-leg trousers, small gold hoop earrings and a beige handbag
chars.SALEH: a young Moroccan man about 21 with short black hair and light stubble, wearing a dusty grey t-shirt, olive work cargo trousers with knee pads, white tile dust on his forearms

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside an unfinished seaside villa in Morocco (bare concrete walls, stacked floor tiles, cement bags). Seen from where the young tiler kneels on the floor: DAUGHTER steps in through the doorway right behind HAJ, glancing curiously straight toward the viewer with a faint surprised smile, head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible, warm morning light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the bare concrete living room of the unfinished villa, HAJ points at the floor and explains how to lay the tiles, SALEH kneels with a trowel nodding attentively, stacks of tiles around, medium shot, faces visible

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the unfinished villa, HAJ suddenly answers his mobile phone, frowning with an annoyed face, one hand raised as if saying wait, bare concrete walls behind him, medium shot

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the doorway of the unfinished villa, HAJ hands some banknotes to DAUGHTER while pointing back inside the house, she takes the money looking pleased, his car keys in his other hand, medium shot, faces visible

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: DAUGHTER walks back alone into the empty unfinished villa, holding a small bakery bag, looking ahead with a confident playful smile, through the open doorway a dusty construction yard and the sea in the distance, medium shot, face visible

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the bare concrete room, DAUGHTER sits on a stack of cement bags very close to SALEH who kneels by the tiles, she leans toward him with narrowed teasing eyes as if asking a pointed question, he freezes holding a tile, medium shot, both faces visible

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of SALEH sweating and stammering nervously, scratching the back of his head, eyes avoiding her, while DAUGHTER beside him raises an eyebrow with arms crossed, unfinished villa interior, faces visible

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the unfinished villa, SALEH gives a shy embarrassed nod, DAUGHTER smiles slyly and satisfied, playing with a strand of her hair, sunlight from a glassless window between them, medium shot, both faces visible
